title: Dependency resolution does not target a fixed PHP version
description: composer.json declares a composer.json that declares no `config.platform.php`. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a composer.json that declares no `config.platform.php`.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a composer.json that declares no `config.platform.php`.
limitation: It matches a composer.json that declares no `config.platform.php` in the parsed composer.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
